notes: Every PASS is limited to the captured public surface and named configuration.
The 220dp freeform window was scrolled to its end on-device; the final language options and Continue control remained visible and tappable-sized instead of being clipped permanently.

A separate Pixel 9 Pro Fold API 36 AVD exercised CLOSED, HALF_OPENED and OPENED device states plus a real Android split-screen task. The public entry remained usable after resize; the low-height split required vertical scrolling and the retained tap opened the sign-in surface.

The edge-to-edge audit passed 108 focused tests across native ownership, themes, entry, V2 shell, nav, sheets and journal editor source contracts; emulator-only or unauthenticated proof is not promoted to private IME/OAuth or physical-device PASS.

The Ukrainian browser large-text defect and the native System label split were both reproduced before their scoped fixes; the final Android 560dpi/font-scale 1.30 captures keep every label whole and the CTA reachable.
The native screen recorder emitted sparse compositor frames and is diagnostic only; it does not prove smoothness.

The retained final instrumentation run kept the real TalkBack service active, matched exact labels for 12 accessibility-focus events and observed TalkBack speech audio-focus requests. This is automation-assisted runtime proof, not human auditory or AT acceptance.

With Android window, transition and animator scales set to zero, WebView reported prefers-reduced-motion=true and ZenFlow applied its static kill-switch even with the runtime performance guard explicitly disabled; emulator settings were restored afterward.

A large-display Android ANR was retained as FAIL evidence and traced to the WebView rendering path. The final narrow fallback removes only the decorative multi-element overlay below 360 CSS pixels while preserving the aurora, edge-bleed gradient and content hierarchy.

No genuine signed-in session was available. The local-only habit create/IME/Back journey is now visually verified on-device, while authenticated connected history, private journal, mood and planning surfaces remain UNVERIFIED.

The local production-preview V2 history entry was inspected on phone, desktop and Hebrew RTL; an overlapping RTL close control was captured as FAIL and then recaptured as PASS after the regression fix.
